name: s81lk_kp4_enc-k4-COMMIT
purpose: S81 link KP4 encoder leaf (one per SerDes link macro), streaming rewrite 10-17. Bench = KP4 base (16/16 parity exact vs rs544.py, 122 frames exact, 17 beyond-t flagged, 0 miscorrected) and encoder mutant EMUT1.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_kp4_enc u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_common.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_enc.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_enc/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_enc/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_enc --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_kp4_enc  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-TILES2 10-17 WIRING-SIZED OUTLINE (k4-1ed8f8336 at 151.2 x 151.2 hit GRT-0116: total overflow 114,794, usage M2 93.4% / M3 96.9% / M4 88.2% / M5 84.4% (total 91.3%), 1.75 m GRT wire, 20k+ congested gcells spread over the whole core, not at the pin faces (p_d 3.9 pins/um W, tx_d 3.9/um E): the cause is the intrinsic all-to-all GF(2) parity lookahead, 123.6k XOR inputs (A loop 300x300 45.3k, P0/P1 260->300 39.3k + 39.0k; 46k XOR2 cells) in 22.9k um2, i.e. the tile was sized from cell area (util 51%) instead of wire demand). Outline 216 x 216 (5 x 43.2 lattice, square, 2.04x tracks; demand/capacity est. 0.45-0.55), place density 0.30 so the XOR fabric spreads over the full core (util ~25%), pins over the full faces: p_d 544 W in 203 um = 2.7/um, tx_d 512 E in 197 um = 2.6/um, clk/rst_n N centre. RTL unchanged (1ed8f8336 streaming encoder, ~7k regs). Previous: S81-KP4 10-17 STREAMING REWRITE (replaces the 8cd04168b kit whose CTS gate FAILED: 17,084 sinks one root, TT insertion 346.5 ps, setup WNS -503.9 ps through the ph barrel window, ph fanout 6,446, W pins packed in 60 um): the parity LFSR runs on the arriving beats (chunk k = {beat k-1, beat k} at a fixed offset, 10:1 one-hot select with 4 kept select copies, no barrel shifter); the 520-bit window matrix parts are computed and registered a cycle ahead (wb), only A rem (<= 173 inputs) is in the loop; beats wait in a 6-deep delay line and each PMA word is a fixed-offset select over {d5, d4} (17 kept select copies). ~6.4k registers (was 17.1k), regional synchronous reset tree (ot_s81_kp4_rst, control only, no datapath reset). RTL latency port->p_d 7 cycles (was 21: -14 for the link latency model) + 2 pin registers (recipe 4). Outline 151.2 x 151.2 (square; gate 1 at 194.4 x 194.4 measured synthesized std 11,033 um2 = util 31%: TT insertion 210-243 ps, spread 32 ps, setup +44 / hold +37 ps); pins spread over the full faces: p_d W (PMA side, 544 in 138 um = 3.9/um), tx_d E (core side), clk / rst_n N centre. Exact vs rs544.py (KP4 bench base PASS 16/16 parity, EMUT1 FAIL).
